settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace appearance, scan behavior, and cache limits.
settings.themeDescription: Choose a stable light or dark interface for long asset inspection sessions.
settings.colorSchemeDescription: Choose the interface primary, secondary, and accent colors from curated presets.
settings.languageDescription: English is the primary interface language; Chinese is available as an auxiliary language.
settings.scanConcurrencyDescription: Number of threads to parse bundle files simultaneously (1-32); higher is faster but increases disk pressure.
settings.typeCacheDescription: Each bundle's MD5 and type list is stored locally, so repeated launches can skip type scanning.
settings.assetMapCacheDescription: Choose where Build Index stores its AssetMap index cache. Resource directories are not modified.
settings.assetMapCacheNote: Each workspace gets its own subfolder under this directory, using the folder name plus a short hash to prevent collisions.
settings.memoryCacheDescription: Cache parsed bundle metadata in memory; switching files does not require re-parsing. Exceeding the limit automatically evicts the oldest cache.
settings.cacheNote: Default 8GB, maximum 48GB. Larger values improve repeated navigation on machines with sufficient RAM.
settings.appDescription: Unity asset inspection, preview, mapping, and export utility for personal research workflows.
settings.githubTokenPlaceholder: Optional token for GitHub API requests
settings.githubTokenHint: Used only when checking GitHub Releases. Empty or invalid-looking tokens are ignored.
settings.supportHint: For discussion and feedback, join QQ group {qq}. Please avoid sharing copyrighted assets or private logs publicly.

updateChecker.noReleaseNotes: This release does not provide release notes.
